ideas.title: Investigating Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the efforts being made to prevent it.
questions: What is the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
What efforts are being made to prevent it?
ideas.insight: This story is important because it highlights the need for accountability and transparency in government programs. By following the money, we can identify areas where fraud is occurring and hold those responsible accountable.

ideas.title: Police Brutality in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the cases of police brutality in Minnesota, including the shooting of Renee Good and Alex Pretti.
questions: What are the circumstances surrounding the shooting of Renee Good and Alex Pretti?
What efforts are being made to address police brutality in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: This story is important because it highlights the need for accountability and transparency in law enforcement. By examining the cases of police brutality, we can identify patterns and hold those responsible accountable.
